statement.text:
What is the structure of the smooth knot concordance group?
(a) Is there a torsion element of the smooth concordance group $\mathcal{C}$ having order
other than two? Is there a torsion element in $\mathcal{C}_{TS}$, the smooth concordance
group of topologically slice knots, having order other than two?
(b) Is there a knot $K$ having concordance order two in $\mathcal{C}$ that is not concordant
to a strongly negatively amphichiral knot?
(c) Do there exist infinitely divisible elements in $\mathcal{C}$, that is, does there exist $K$
such that for infinitely many $n \in \mathbb{N}$, there is a $J$ such that $[K] = n[J]$?
